hooks.name: Auto Push ke GitHub
hooks.description: Auto git add, commit, dan push ke GitHub setiap kali file PHP/CSS/JS/JSON disimpan di workspace.

action.command: cd "c:\php\htdocs\education_hp" && git add . && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "auto: update $(git diff --cached --name-only | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ')" && git push
